in_greek.name: Καμίλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Καμίλα είναι το όνομα που προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'κοντοκράτος' ή 'φυτό'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα αυτό, αλλά συνδέεται με ονόματα φυτών και λουλουδιών που αναφέρονται στα Ιερά Κείμενα. Το όνομα Καμίλα χρησιμοποιείται ευρέως ανάμεσα στους Χριστιανούς και θεωρείται ένα όμορφο και χαρισματικό όνομα.

data.cultural_impact: The name Camilla is rich in history and culture. It has its roots in Latin origin and was used as a name for attendant maids or younger sisters. In ancient mythology, Camilla was also the name of an Amazon queen known for her warrior skills and independence. This name has been popular in various cultures and centuries, from ancient Rome to medieval Europe and beyond. Today, Camilla is a name that evokes a sense of strength, uniqueness, and grace.
data.spiritual_significance: Camilla is a name that carries deep spiritual significance for Christians. It is associated with two holy saints: Saint Camilla de'Rossano and Saint Camilla of Capua. Both saints were remarkable women of faith who lived their lives dedicated to God. Saint Camilla de'Rossano was a hermit who lived in solitude and devoted herself to prayer and penance. Her courage and unwavering faith earned her the title "The Lady of the Castle." Saint Camilla of Capua, on the other hand, was a very young nun who died of natural causes at the young age of 18. Her mystical experiences and deep devotion to God continue to inspire and awe people today. Camilla is a name that symbolizes purity, faith, and courage in the face of adversity, making it a beautiful and meaningful name for a Christian girl.
